description: Prepare one expense proposal and return its separate MBC approval link. A proposal does not record an expense or make a payment. amountMinor is an integer in the connected account currency’s ISO minor units (EUR 12.34 = 1234; JPY 123 = 123), using the minorUnitDigits from its budget totals. requestKey identifies one proposal idempotently across retries and reconnections. paid specifies paid versus planned status. Only a separate human confirmation on MBC can record the proposal.
name: prepare_expense
title: Prepare one MBC expense
